title: Monotone Allocations without Single-Crossing: When to Bunch and When to Jump
abstract: arXiv:2608.19474v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A principal screens an agent whose technology has a minimum efficient scale, so the Spence-Mirrlees condition fails along a monotone dividing curve: the locus at which every type values marginal output equally. For the class in which this curve and the relaxed solution are both strictly monotone, the optimal contract obeys a trichotomy, governed by how the two meet: a jump is impossible when they never meet, unavoidable across a flat dividing curve, a choice across a strictly increasing one. The optimum is found, not conjectured: each solution is certified as globally optimal among all implementable allocations, deterministic or random, by dualizing the family of binding constraints through an explicit weight; the certificates require neither linear primitives nor any restriction on the shape of the contract. Under mild regularity the class comprises exactly forty configurations; each is mapped to its forced shape, solved in closed form,

translated_title: 单调分配无需单一交叉：何时聚束，何时跳跃
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19474v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一位委托人筛选一位技术具有最小有效规模的代理人，因此Spence-Mirrlees条件在一条单调分割曲线上失效：该曲线是每种类型对边际产出评价相等的轨迹。对于该曲线和松弛解均为严格单调的类别，最优契约遵循三分法，由两者如何相交决定：当它们永不相交时，跳跃是不可能的；当分割曲线平坦时，跳跃不可避免；当分割曲线严格递增时，跳跃是选择性的。最优解是被找到而非猜测的：每个解通过显式权重对约束族进行对偶化，被证明在所有可实施的分配（无论是确定性的还是随机的）中是全局最优的；这些证明不需要线性原始条件，也不限制契约的形状。在温和的正则性条件下，该类别恰好包含四十种配置；每种配置都被映射到其强制形状，并以闭式解求解。
tldr: 本文在单一交叉条件失效时，通过显式对偶方法证明了最优契约的全局最优性，并分类了所有四十种配置下的强制形状（聚束或跳跃）。
en_tdlr: This paper proves global optimality of contracts when single-crossing fails, classifying all forty configurations into forced shapes of bunching or jumping via explicit dual certificates.
